page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are abbreviated references and short citations, transcribed as printed where legible. Some are partly illegible (for example the note beside "Qui placi-" and the Lamias passage); the Greek word "μωεἰων" is an uncertain reading. Several words in the main text are doubtful, notably "Fatuitatem!" and "Euangelista" in the Apostolus quotation. The mark "ƒ" at the lower right is a stray mark, not text.
